build_change_video_fps: build a python module to change video FPS by interpolating frames from the first 5 seconds of MP4 files
create_change_video_fps: create a function that reads MP4 videos from a folder, resamples frames to a new FPS via linear interpolation, and writes output videos
test_change_video_fps: test the change_video_fps function with input and output folder paths and a target FPS value
refactor_change_video_fps: refactor the change_video_fps function to support configurable subclip duration instead of a fixed 5 seconds
